title: Korea Stocks Tumble 8% as Investors Rush to Unwind AI Exposure
key_facts: KOSPI fell 7.81% to 5,539.34 at the time of writing on Thursday 15 Oct 2026.
SK Hynix fell 11.42% and Samsung Electronics fell 8.84% in Seoul.
Japan's Nikkei 225 fell 4.12%, with SoftBank Group down 9.34%.
Wall Street's Nasdaq Composite fell 1.88% on Wednesday and the S&P 500 fell 1.11%.
US consumer prices rose 3.7% year on year in September, up from 3.4% in August.
The Federal Reserve raised rates to 3.75%-4% on 16 Sept and one more rise is expected this year (Benzinga).
Broadcom chief executive Hock Tan said access to capital could become a bigger obstacle for AI than chips or power.
quote_evidence: SK Hynix Inc. shares tumbled more than 11% in Seoul on Thursday, deepening a global chip selloff tied to hotter U.S. inflation, Federal Reserve rate-hike bets and doubts over funding the artificial intelligence buildout.
why_it_matters_hint: A global chip sell-off tied to inflation and AI funding doubts is hitting Asian chip makers hardest.
